summary: Created a 5-phase plan that fixes contract drift at its root in this (healthy) source-of-truth repo by registering "contracts" in core/manifest.json provides.context and migrating the 8 core contract files into the core extension source, extends check-extension-docs.sh with provides.context disk-existence validation and a deployed-file dangling-contract-reference scan, wires the validator into sync.lua's Load Core path with loud non-silent failure, and documents the provides.context sync contract plus a downstream reconciliation procedure (no direct edits to other child repos).
